QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts 3] Executive Privilege
QuestInfo.0: It doesn't look like #bKrania#k has any intention of going with you willingly. You'll have to drag her along to help put a stop to Scion's plans.
QuestInfo.2: After all of #bKrania's#k bodyguards were dealt with, #bSpencer#k asked for Krania's help as politely as he could. But will his pleas fall on deaf ears?
